print.name: Tonie figure holder for IKEA Skadis V1
print.summary: Holder for Tonie figures with a metal plate inside. Compatible with IKEA Skadis and Uppspel pegboards
print.description:
Holder for the magnetic figures of the Tonies-Brand.

Inside the Holder, there is a 35x2mm cutout for a steel disc so the figures will stick to the holder. The double-holder (with 2 discs) fits for the bigger tonies like the ones from Disneys “Cars”

Fits the slots of IKEA Skadis and Uppspel pegboards. On a 56x56cm board you can place about 36 of the single holders which stores about 72 Tonie figures.

Materials:

  • PLA or PETG in the colour of your choice
  • Steel disc 35x2mm
    • I used these from supermagnete.ch and they deliver in most of europe.
    • Users have reported success in using 30mm washers (see comment section)

Printing:

  • Use the “filament change” or “pause” function to stop the print to place the disc, then print over it
  • adjust number of walls for the hook-part to make it filled completely with walls
